snapshot: Vertex Cloud Solutions is a B2B SaaS company selling cloud infrastructure contracts ($50K–$500K ACV) to mid-market enterprises. Roughly 80 new logos per year. Finance, sales, and ops run on HubSpot and NetSuite with no live sync between them.

confirmedFlows.name: Revenue Alerts
confirmedFlows.triggerDetail: Invoice overdue, renewal approaching, subscription created

phase1.label: Connected
phase1.headline: Closed-Won to Invoiced Without the Relay
phase1.body: HubSpot Closed-Won triggers automatic NetSuite customer, subscription, and invoice creation. Invoice payment status syncs back to HubSpot. Slack fires on billing events. No manual handoff.

phase2.label: Automated
phase2.headline: Revenue Health Monitoring, Automatic Escalations
phase2.body: 30-day overdue → HubSpot task + Slack ping. 60-day → revenue ops escalation. 90-day → leadership flag. Renewal opportunities auto-create 90 days before contract end.

phase3.label: Agentic
phase3.headline: Revenue Questions That Answer Themselves
phase3.body: Which accounts have overdue invoices and no HubSpot activity? Which closed-won deals have no NetSuite subscription? The model answers these every Monday — your team reviews exceptions, not spreadsheets.

operational-pragmatist: relay fails at least once a week

psychologyProfile.primaryPainQuote: Every Closed-Won deal triggers a manual relay — sales tells finance, finance logs into NetSuite, someone creates the record. 48 hours. Every time.
psychologyProfile.aspirationQuote: I want the deal to close and the invoice to go out the same day.
excitementPhrases: finally have live data in both systems
this is exactly what we need

contentModifiers.challengeFraming: Open with a cost or time figure from their transcript — even an estimate. Anchor the challenge in a number they recognized when they said it.
contentModifiers.fomoFraming: Lead with the dollar amount or hours recovered. Name the number before naming the company. Structure: '{$X saved} by connecting {systems} — here is how.'
contentModifiers.journeyFraming: Stage 1 bullet items must cite operational outcomes with implied measurement. Stage 3 must answer: 'which specific operational question will AI answer, and what decision does that remove from a human's plate?'
contentModifiers.closingLineVariant: The managed service model turns the ROI calculation into a single line: the cost of staying manual vs. the monthly service rate.
